beats.say: Most Star Wars games let you fight, but one let you choose your path.

shots.src: commons-search:Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic

beats.say: BioWare created the entire Knights of the Old Republic experience in just three years.
You begin the game stranded, waking up on a doomed ship with no memory of your past.
You must gather companions and hunt for ancient Star Maps to locate the legendary Star Forge.
Depending on your choices, you will either defeat the Sith or claim the power for yourself.

meta.summary: BioWare created the legendary Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic in just three years, crafting a story where player choices determine the fate of the galaxy.
meta.comment: Would you choose the light side or the dark side?
sources: Wikipedia, Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
facts: Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic is a media franchise of role-playing video games created and developed by BioWare.
The game opens with the player character awakening aboard a doomed Republic capital ship with no recollection of their past.
The main character and their companions search for Star Maps that reveal the location of the Star Forge.
Depending on alignment, characters reach the Star Forge either to defeat the Sith or to usurp control from Malak.
